description: Get a mutual-fund scheme's NAV (net asset value) history from MFAPI — fund house, category, ISIN, latest NAV, and the most-recent NAV points (newest first). Use search_schemes to find a scheme_code first (e.g. 118550). Keyless.

limit.description: Number of most-recent NAV points to return (default 30, max 120).

scheme_code.description: AMFI scheme code, e.g. 118550. Get one from search_schemes.

name: get_nav_history
